args.message: I added up revenue and credit limits by region separately, then put the two results side by side. Adding them separately keeps a customer's credit limit from being counted once for every order they placed. The credit totals include every customer, whether or not they ever ordered. The null row holds orders whose customer has no known region (1,193.30 in revenue) and the one customer with no region (500 credit limit). Those orders may also include any whose customer isn't on the customer list; I didn't check that separately.
